messages:
elaine_docs: Drafted the changelog entry for the routing-policy tweak (aiming for a short blurb + expanded migration note). Putting it in `releases/2024-09-routing` branch. Need a quick engineering sanity check before I hand to l10n.

frank_pm: Dropping a couple of asks: 1) Add a short user-facing example for 'pin to region', 2) Call out known issue with embeddings regen after rollback.

elaine_docs: OK. I added a Known Issues bullet but it's very terse. Can someone add repro steps or link to the internal ticket? I don't want long debug logs in the public note.

toby_backend: I'll add a concise repro. Proposed text: "On rare rollbacks, embeddings may show stale vectors for ~2-5 minutes while cache invalidation completes; trigger a reindex or wait for automatic reconciliation." I'll link TKT-1147 too.

nina_infra: Heads up: our anchor for the dedicated config section changed last week from `#region-pinning` to `#pinning` — anchor-checker will flag it. Use canonical `/docs/dedicated/configuration#pinning`.

elaine_docs: Good catch. I had `/docs/dedicated/configuration#region-pinning` in one spot. Replaced with canonical.

link-checker-bot: link-check: /docs/dedicated/configuration#pinning => OK, /docs/regions/eu-central => 200, /docs/regions/apac => 302 -> /docs/regions/ap-southeast (use canonical).

frank_pm: For the SDK examples: our Python snippet is fine, but the Go example still uses the older sync call pattern. Can someone update to the streaming style? Small sample would be appreciated.

elaine_docs: Here's the current Go snippet in the draft:
```
resp, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), "redwood/kitefish-2000", opts)
fmt.Println(resp.Output[0].Content)
```
We need to change to streaming.

toby_backend: Update suggestion:
```
stream, _ := client.Completions.Stream(context.Background(), "redwood/kitefish-2000", opts)
for stream.Next() {
  chunk := stream.Value()
  fmt.Print(chunk.Text)
}
```
Keep it minimal and add a note: "Use streaming for lower-latency single-token output."

nina_infra: Also reminder to set the changelog front-matter `unrelease: true` until PR sign-off. We use that to prevent accidental publish.

elaine_docs: Done. Front-matter updated and I added `{{i18n}}` markers for headings that need translation.

frank_pm: Localisation note: please keep placeholders consistent. We prefer `%s` for tokens in release notes rather than handlebars.

elaine_docs: Switched placeholders to `%s`. Thanks.

link-checker-bot: anchor-check (post-edit): /docs/release-notes/2024-routing => OK, /docs/regions/ap-southeast => 200, /docs/dedicated/configuration#pinning => OK.

elaine_docs: Pushed PR #5120 with the edits, includes updated JS/Python/Go snippets, Known Issues blurb, anchor fixes, and front-matter.

frank_pm: Quick review done, left one nit on wording. Otherwise LGTM. I'll add :shipit: once the JS snippet uses `client.completions.create` (we swapped last quarter).

elaine_docs: JS updated to:
```
const resp = await client.completions.create({ model: "redwood/kitefish-2000", input: "Explain..." });
console.log(resp.output_text);
```
Marked for l10n.

toby_backend: I've added the TKT-1147 link and a concise repro line. Keeping it non-technical.

nina_infra: Final check: CI will run a regex to catch any leftover `/docs/regions/apac` strings. Make sure none remain.

elaine_docs: Ran grep across branch, zero hits. CI preview looks clean.

frank_pm: OK folks — if everyone signs off, we flip `unrelease: false` after the embargo window and publish. Please leave :eyes: or :shipit: reactions on PR #5120.

elaine_docs: Thanks all. Closing thread; PR contains final checklist and the staging preview link.
